translations.answer: Call computeJointJacobians to update the cache. If the end-effector frame coincides with the joint, read the joint Jacobian; otherwise, read the frame Jacobian. Must explicitly verify WORLD, LOCAL, or LOCAL_WORLD_ALIGNED, and not rely solely on matrix values. The result must be cross-verified against official documentation and unit tests during version upgrades.
translations.applicability: Applies to the Pinocchio joint/frame Jacobian API; verify against current documentation and unit tests during version upgrades.
translations.credibility.rationale: Environmental, processing steps, and results have engineering records, but formal cross-verification or independent replication is lacking.
translations.details.attempts.0: Discuss using Talos configuration scripts to compare frames and joints in WORLD reference frame.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: First check if computeJointJacobians is called, then verify if the end-effector frame is defined and the selected reference frame.
translations.details.effective_fixes.0: Calculate all joint Jacobians; if end-effector and joint coincide, read joint Jacobian, else read frame Jacobian.
translations.details.environments.0: Pinocchio, end-effector frame, WORLD/LOCAL/LOCAL_WORLD_ALIGNED reference frames.
translations.details.limits.0: Equality in WORLD space depends on Pinocchio's definition of the reference frame, and cannot be directly applied to LOCAL or LOCAL_WORLD_ALIGNED.
translations.details.outcomes.0: Maintainer provides a runnable validation script and closes Issue, but further user input is needed for conceptual discussion.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: Unable to determine whether to use joint or frame Jacobian, and why they might be equal in WORLD space.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: Mixing up cache calculation functions and retrieval functions, and confusing the Frame class with reference frames.
translations.details.symptoms.0: API returns Jacobian matrix inconsistent with intuitive end-effector speed mapping.
